items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Two-line change with a clear comment ('# Ensure base table is in aliases.') that fits the existing style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Calls the existing helper query.get_initial_alias(). No duplicated logic, dead code or debug leftovers, and Collector/QuerySet.delete are untouched.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Nothing new to break: no exception handling or constants added. get_initial_alias is idempotent, and the property is a cached_property.

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: Fixes the root cause in single_alias by calling get_initial_alias() before counting aliases, which also covers the MySQL compiler. Joined deletes still get the subquery. Same as the reference; F2P 1/1 and P2P 52/52 pass.
